content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint against a company with the National Commission, which is then assigned to a Bench consisting of three members. The senior-most member of the Bench presides over the hearing.
content.outcome: The National Commission Bench, presided over by the senior-most member, has the authority to exercise the jurisdiction, powers, and authority of the National Commission, as per Section 58(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the composition of a National Commission Bench?
